----------------------------------------------
Pikmin are mysterious animal-like and plant-like creatures with leaves and flowers on their heads. They live together with Captain Olimar, an astronaut who came to their planet, collecting various treasures on the planet. Pikmin are usually active in games, but this time they have stepped out of the game world and become CG animations. Three short stories can be enjoyed in 3D (of course, 2D viewing is also possible): ``Midnight Juice'' where Captain Olimar makes his favorite juice, ``Treasure in a Bottle'' where Pikmin encounters a mysterious treasure, and ``An Extraordinary Day'', a grand spectacle that unfolds at a construction site.
